boundaries.policy: @croco/repository-core is an interface layer and must not mention Drizzle implementation details in src.

deltaPolicy.description: Spine package artifacts may not grow by any positive byte delta over the committed baseline.

compatibilityTrain.policy: Internal @croco/* workspace dependencies use workspace:* except checked peer-only semver exceptions; generated app workspace ranges resolve through the exported tested spine dependency set.

fixedLinkedDecision.decision: Compatibility-train validation is sufficient for the current 1.0 spine; fixed/linked groups remain intentionally empty.
